gen-audiowide-gf-voces: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide stamps each letter out of a rigid grid. It earns its keep big and brief, while Voces trails with a slight swell on its bowls and tall lowercase.
gen-audiowide-plus-jakarta-sans: Futuristic tiles with wide grout lines: that's Audiowide. Plus Jakarta Sans then keeps reading smooth across paragraphs, its monoline strokes and moderate lowercase height giving the eye plenty of room.
gen-cinzel-decorative-fs-spline-sans: Cinzel Decorative spaces its capitals wide and carries a shimmer of weight. Spline Sans sits beneath with wide gaps at its curve ends, so the tall-bodied heading and the shorter sans-serif text meet without crowding.
gen-comfortaa-gf-albert-sans: Neon-tube roundness and stretched spacing, all friendly: that's Comfortaa. Albert Sans takes over for reading, apertures staying open at tiny sizes and strokes keeping one thickness in every direction.
gen-comfortaa-gf-alef: Alef keeps a modern, clean voice, its open-ended curves running right through every line of text it sets. The hook is Comfortaa: neon-tube strokes with no contrast between stems and joins.
gen-comfortaa-gf-almarai: Almarai keeps its line width from ever swelling or tapering, and its sans-serif letters never seem to pinch shut. Beside friendly, stretched-out Comfortaa, it feels quietly grounded and steady.
gen-comfortaa-gf-amarna: Amarna draws contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal, with small counters left unclogged. What links them is a constant line: Comfortaa bends it into neon-tube rings while the sans keeps it clean.
gen-comfortaa-gf-andika: Andika reads as modern, its tails and terminals matching the main stems, its s turns wide and easy. And Comfortaa meets it with neon-tube rings and stretched spacing that loosen the whole look.
gen-comfortaa-gf-anta: Round, stretched and friendly, Comfortaa looks like neon tubing bent into letters. Anta brings the wire-bent sign look at constant thickness, and its gaping e keeps company with those loose rings.
gen-comfortaa-gf-antic: A c shaped like a wide-open ring is the signature of Comfortaa, stretched out in neon-tube strokes. Antic, a one-nib sans, keeps longer reading unhurried through its open letter mouths.
